_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Batch S4 (Joolz/M&P/Mima). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joolz Hub+ (covers Hub / Hub+)

clekListed.clekRow: Joolz Hub — Hub Infant Car Seat Adapter – Cybex/Nuna (902000)

specs._dimsNote: Folded with seat ~25 x 21 x 12 in; folded without seat ~10.5 in high. 21-in width fits many store aisles.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: 6 months to 4 years; from birth only with the Joolz cocoon/carrycot or a car seat

safety.standards: EN 1888-2 (Joolz). Clek's official list attests the model was tested to the applicable ASTM stroller/car-seat standard for Liing use.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; compact urban chassis; 5-US-gal / 11-lb basket. Hub+ seat is world-facing (not reversible).

specs.foldType: compact fold (seat can stay attached), self-standing
specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest (exact positions not published)
specs.tires: 6.3 in front / 10.3 in rear EVA foam-coated wheels

notes: Lightweight full-size urban stroller (24.3 lb). Clek lists the Hub with the Joolz Hub adapter 902000, whose product name enumerates Cybex/Nuna (Maxi-Cosi-footprint) seats; Clek's authoritative list attests the Liing is compatible via this adapter even though the M&P/Joolz product name does not spell out 'Clek'. Best in-stock price $473.85 (Mega Babies sale); Joolz DTC MSRP $729. Reversibility not explicitly published; Hub+ seat is world-facing only.
